value.rationale: Complete three-level feedforward graphs with no long shortcuts are natural basic directed-network objects. Their Mayer N-complexes have three distinct degree-two representation stages, including an all-three-level augmentation tensor absent from single-source/sink motifs, and give a complete product-symmetric-group character classification for every level width and Mayer parameter. This supplies a reusable exact structural benchmark for higher-order directed homology beyond a finite census or a routine specialization.
